checklist.text: Register with Karnataka State Physiotherapy Council
Secure Ground Floor / Elevator-Equipped Premises in BLR
Register Clinic under KPME Act (Karnataka Medical Establishments)
Obtain BBMP Trade License & BMWM Waste Agreement
Procure Essential Modalities (TENS, IFT, Ultrasound, Rehab Gear)
Setup & Verify Google My Business Profile (Direct-to-Consumer Local SEO)
Secure 6-Month Working Capital Cushion for Rent & Payroll
